name: Prisma Ohma
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: public Capture, Rescue or low-level Exterminate for fast cracks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts downgraded from vaulted relics); 450 is about 5 gold parts or 10 silver.
bonuses: Solo or squad Capture, Rescue or low-level Exterminate on a speed or nuke frame (Titania, Volt, Mag, Sevagoth, Voruna, Gyre) cracks relics fastest; in public matches run Defense instead so you aren't stuck waiting at extraction.
Void Cascade with a competent group is the fastest fissure and also drops sellable arcanes; Conjunction Survival and Excavation fissures work too.
Squads mean four chances per relic at the gold or silver part, so sell duplicates you don't need rather than farming from zero.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Void Surplus is a trap for this: 50,000 credits for a 2% chance at 1,000 ducats. Aya to Ducats at Varzia is 5 ducats per Aya, an extremely poor rate. Both are last resorts only.

groups.meta: stock rotates irregularly, 1-8 months between visits

rows.label: Prisma Ohma
rows.note: built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or platinum trade for an unranked copy between visits

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Ohma isn't guaranteed even when he is. It has appeared 11 times since August 2023, with gaps of up to 8 months.
Type `when baro` in Region or Relay chat, or check a Ducat Kiosk countdown, to see which relay he's visiting, and make sure that planet is unlocked on your star chart.
MR12 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
It has also appeared as TennoCon relay stock, which needs Baro's Relay Ticket from the TennoCon Digital Pack.

disclosures.title: why it's worth grabbing on sight
disclosures.body: Its innate electricity frees a mod slot on a Melee Influence build, and its heavy attack forces Slash procs, which suits Tennokai. A 2026 tier list ranked it second among tonfas behind Praedos, commonly paired with Saryn, Kullervo, Gyre, Volt and Roar builds.
